messages:
riley (AM): FYI Sylvan MedTech wants to run a 3-week POC next week. Primary ask: validate model fit for clinical summarization. They want to test a 7B int4 variant for cost and a 70B fp16 for edge cases. Also procurement asked for a POC token pricing for ~50M tokens/month and a brief security confirmation (weights isolation + EU residency).

nina (sales-eng): Suggested POC pricing: hosted tokens at 25% off + waived infra for first 72h. Will this be ok? They need a short note for procurement. :memo:

priya (infra): 25% hosted discount is fine. Dedicated pool for 7B-int4 is doable; int4 paths need runtime support — we should confirm compatibility. 70B fp16 will likely live on hosted (multi-tenant) in eu-west-1 due to capacity.

ci-bot: Ran quick model registry scan: hf.co/sylvan/medqa-1 (v2) available. Checksum verified.

tomo (ml eng): I pulled hf.co/sylvan/medqa-1 and ran a compatibility pass. Command I used:
```
./compat-scan --model hf://sylvan/medqa-1 --quant targets=int4,fp16 --runtime rwd-v2
```
Findings: tokenizer ok. INT4 export present but uses a custom fused matmul that our int4 kernels don't support yet — runtime will fall back to a generic kernel with ~20-30% token latency penalty for int4 paths. FP16 path is clean.

lucas (solutions): Customer expected average request ~350 tokens, peak 1024. They also want latency SLOs for integration tests and an eval harness they can run. Can we provide perf numbers by EOD?

tomo (ml eng): Quick local numbers (single replica, batch=1):
- 7B-int4 (dedicated fallback): 350 -> 95ms avg, 1024 -> 360ms avg (note: fallback kernels included)
- 70B-fp16 (hosted): 350 -> 420ms avg, 1024 -> 1.4s avg
I'll run a 12h throughput test overnight and upload CSV.

priya (infra): Routing recommendation: primary route to dedicated 7B-int4; if latency >800ms or replica saturation then route to hosted 70B. Sketch config:
```
routing {
  primary: sylvan/7b-int4@dedicated
  fallback: sylvan/70b-fp16@hosted-eu
  p99_timeout_ms: 800
}
```
This keeps P99 under control while giving high-accuracy fallback.

nina (sales-eng): Procurement wants a one-paragraph data residency note: will say POC traffic and logs are kept in eu-west-1 and keys in regional KMS. Is that accurate?

priya (infra): Yes — we can pin traffic to eu-west-1 and store logs in the EU tenancy. Keys can be isolated via customer-specific KMS keys. For private / on-prem customers we can enable HSM-backed KMS.

lucas (solutions): Security Q draft: "Weights are encrypted at rest (AES-256). For Dedicated pools weights are stored on isolated volumes accessible only by the serving nodes; KMS keys are customer-isolated. For Private deployments we support an HSM-backed key lifecycle and air-gapped options." I'll refine and drop into #sales-docs. :lock:

riley (AM): Action list: (1) tomo: full perf CSV + 12h throughput run (2) lucas: security Q + SOW wording for region pinning & fallback (3) nina: pricing blurb for procurement and SOW clause about 72h free infra (4) priya: reserve dedicated 7B pool and confirm exact instance types / capacity.

tomo (ml eng): On it. Also note: INT4 fallback penalty might make cost parity worse; recommend we benchmark end-to-end cost per 1k tokens with fallback enabled vs hosted 70B.

nina (sales-eng): I'll prepare a short procurement note: "POC pricing: hosted token rates with a 25% discount for first billing cycle; dedicated infra waived for first 72 hours of provisioning. POC estimated volume: 50M tokens/month — SOW to include region pinning to eu-west-1 and routing fallback to hosted 70B for high-complexity queries."

priya (infra): Reserving a 3-node 7B pool now (expected: g5.12x or equivalent). Will confirm exact CPU/GPU and peak tokens/sec. Note: sustained >50% for >2 weeks triggers capacity review and may require commitment.

ci-bot: Uploaded initial compat report: hf://artifacts/sylvan/compat/1872613333-report.txt

lucas (solutions): I'll add HSM language and provide the security questionnaire answers. Dropping files in #sales-docs shortly.

riley (AM): Please tag me when CSV + security file are in. We need to send a one-page summary to Sylvan procurement and legal before kickoff.

tomo (ml eng): Uploaded perf CSV: hf://artifacts/sylvan/poc/perf-1872613333.csv. 12h run scheduled.

priya (infra): Confirmed: dedicated pool = 3x g5.12x equivalents, estimated sustained throughput ~4.7k tokens/s, region: eu-west-1.

nina (sales-eng): Drafted procurement blurb and SOW snippet, will post link to the doc in channel once it's in #sales-docs.

riley (AM): Great work. If the 12h run looks good we'll finalize pricing and sign the POC SOW. Ping me directly for any urgent blockers. :thumbsup:
